title: Extracción de Conocimiento en Bases de Datos - 9B
summary: A student coursework repository of Jupyter notebooks for a data extraction/analysis class, culminating in a sales Data Warehouse built with PostgreSQL and Python; one lab notebook (Lab10.ipynb) imports SDV and SDMetrics to fit a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on client data and evaluate it with a QualityReport, so SDV's tabular synthesizer is run as a course exercise.
evidence: Notebooks/Lab10.ipynb:39-49: 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' and 'from sdmetrics.reports.single_table import QualityReport'
